newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - PaineWebber starts bank stocks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - PaineWebber starts bank stocks.

text.p: Bank stock analyst Ruchi Madan, who recently joined PaineWebber Group Inc from Prudential Securities, issued a series ratings on bank stocks Friday.
PaineWebber said that Madan started coverage of Chase Manhattan Corp, Bank of New York Co Inc, BankBoston Corp, Norwest Corp and NationsBank Corp with buy ratings.
He rated Banc One Corp and KeyCorp as attractive.
Bank stocks receiving neutral ratings were Mellon Bank Corp, PNC Bank Corp, Huntington Bancshares Inc, Barnett Banks Inc and First Tennessee National Corp.
